defective_pattern: Premature interpretation of statistical results in Chapter 4, accompanied by hyperbolic, emotional, or dramatic wording.
why_defective: Chapter 4 is strictly for reporting observed descriptive and inferential parameters. Speculative interpretation belongs in Chapter 5. Academic tone must remain rigorously neutral and sober.
observed_symptoms: Presence of subjective adjectives (e.g., 'shocking', 'dramatic', 'huge', 'surprising') in Chapter 4.
Sentences explaining *why* a result occurred rather than just reporting the test statistic, p-value, and effect size.
Blending discussion elements into the results section.
corrective_remedy: Remove all explanatory or speculative text from Chapter 4. Report only the statistical test, df, test statistic value, p-value, and effect size. Strip all emotional or dramatic adjectives, enforcing a neutral, sober academic tone.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of interpretive phrases or dramatic adjectives in Chapter 4 drafts.
